candidate_evidence.quote: Interleukin-12 (other names: IL-12): Given subcutaneously at dose of 6ug twice for interval of one hour.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Treatment-naïve patients after Resection of Glioblastoma.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Assays including Flow Cytometry and Elispot will be employed to determine if cellular and humoral immunity were induced by serial vaccination with DC/Tumor Fusion Cells and IL-12.

role_evidence.quote: Dendritic Cell/Tumor Fusion Vaccine (other names: DC/tumor cell fusion vaccine): Vaccine is derived from the participants dendritic cells and tumor cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic cell/glioma cell fusion vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Fusion cells will be administered with IL-12 to enhance the immunity of patients.
In basic treatment phase, patients will receive concomitant radiation and TMZ-chemotherapy.

coder_notes: Single-arm; IL-12 is the only investigational non-excluded agent (given with a dendritic cell fusion vaccine), so experimental_monotherapy per the vaccine+drug worked example. Target engagement coded yes from immunological assays of vaccine plus IL-12 response in blood (borderline: not separable from vaccine).
